seo.title: Personal account - PVP Tetris
seo.description: Open your PVP Tetris personal account to view your rank, MMR, match history, quick settings and account status.
seo.ogDescription: Track your seasonal progress, wins, win rate, rank and recent matches in your PVP Tetris account.
